User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Transcend Logistics Hub, storing their profile information and linking to their roles and activities. This entity assumes an external authentication system manages credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The user's primary email address, used for communication.

contactNumber.description: The user's primary contact phone number.

city.description: The city where the user resides.

country.description: The country where the user resides.

postalCode.description: The postal code for the user's address.

profileImageUrl.description: URL to the user's profile image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was last updated.

roleIds.description: References to Roles assigned to the user. (Relationship: User N:N Role)

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Defines a role within the Transcend Logistics Hub, such as Admin, Vendor, Transporter, etc., controlling access and capabilities.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Role entity.

description.description: A description of the role's responsibilities and permissions.

permissions.description: A list of permission strings associated with this role.

MembershipPlan.title: MembershipPlan
MembershipPlan.description: Defines the different membership plans available in the Transcend Logistics Hub, such as Access, Reward, Loyalty.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MembershipPlan entity.

name.description: The name of the membership plan (e.g., 'Access', 'Reward', 'Loyalty').

description.description: A detailed description of the membership plan's benefits and features.

price.description: The base price of the membership plan.

currency.description: The currency of the membership price (e.g., 'ZAR').

durationInMonths.description: The duration of the membership plan in months.

features.description: A list of key features included in the plan.

isActive.description: Indicates if the membership plan is currently active and available for subscription.

UserMembership.title: UserMembership
UserMembership.description: Tracks a user's subscription to a specific MembershipPlan, including start/end dates and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserMembership entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this membership. (Relationship: User 1:N UserMembership)

membershipPlanId.description: Reference to the MembershipPlan subscribed to. (Relationship: MembershipPlan 1:N UserMembership)

startDate.description: The date when the membership became active.

endDate.description: The date when the membership is set to expire.

status.description: The current status of the membership (e.g., 'active', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'pending').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the membership record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the membership record was last updated.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Records details of a financial transaction within the platform, such as membership payments, loan repayments, or marketplace purchases.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who made the payment. (Relationship: User 1:N Payment)

paymentDate.description: The date and time when the payment was processed.

transactionId.description: The transaction ID from the payment gateway or system.

description.description: A brief description of what the payment was for (e.g., 'Membership subscription', 'Loan repayment').

userMembershipId.description: Optional reference to a UserMembership if this payment is for a membership. (Relationship: UserMembership 1:1 Payment)

orderId.description: Optional reference to an Order if this payment is for a marketplace order. (Relationship: Order 1:1 Payment)

loanId.description: Optional reference to a Loan if this payment is a loan repayment. (Relationship: Loan 1:N Payment)

userSaaSSubscriptionId.description: Optional reference to a UserSaaSSubscription if this payment is for a SaaS subscription. (Relationship: UserSaaSSubscription 1:N Payment)

Loan.title: Loan
Loan.description: Represents a loan application or disbursement from the Funding Division.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Loan entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who applied for the loan. (Relationship: User 1:N Loan)

amountRequested.description: The amount of funds requested by the user.

amountApproved.description: The amount of funds approved for the loan, if applicable.

currency.description: The currency of the loan amounts (e.g., 'ZAR').

purpose.description: The stated purpose for which the loan is requested.

status.description: The current status of the loan (e.g., 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'disbursed', 'repaid').

applicationDate.description: The date and time when the loan application was submitted.

approvalDate.description: The date and time when the loan was approved, if applicable.

interestRate.description: The annual interest rate applied to the loan.

disbursementDate.description: The date and time when the loan funds were disbursed.

expectedRepaymentDate.description: The date by which the loan is expected to be fully repaid.

terms.description: Detailed terms and conditions of the loan, possibly as a text block or link to a document.

MallCategory.title: MallCategory
MallCategory.description: Represents a specialist mall category within the eCommerce platform (e.g., Supplier Mall, Transport Mall).

id.description: Unique identifier for the MallCategory entity.

name.description: The name of the mall category (e.g., 'Supplier Mall', 'Transport Mall').

description.description: A description of the mall category.

imageUrl.description: URL to an image representing the mall category.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a business or individual (Vendor) offering products or services within the Mall or Marketplace divisions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vendor entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User account associated with managing this Vendor profile. (Relationship: User 1:1 Vendor)

name.description: The official business name of the vendor.

description.description: A description of the vendor's business and offerings.

contactEmail.description: The primary contact email for the vendor.

contactPhone.description: The primary contact phone number for the vendor.

address.description: The physical address of the vendor's business.

websiteUrl.description: The official website URL for the vendor.

logoUrl.description: URL to the vendor's logo image.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the vendor profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the vendor profile was last updated.

mallCategoryIds.description: References to MallCategories where this vendor operates. (Relationship: MallCategory N:N Vendor)

ProductService.title: ProductService
ProductService.description: Represents a product or service offered by a Vendor within the Mall or Marketplace divisions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ProductService entity.

vendorId.description: Reference to the Vendor offering this product or service. (Relationship: Vendor 1:N ProductService)

name.description: The name of the product or service.

description.description: A detailed description of the product or service.

price.description: The price of the product or service.

category.description: A general category for the product or service (e.g., 'transportation', 'warehousing', 'software').

imageUrl.description: URL to an image of the product or service.

isAvailable.description: Indicates if the product or service is currently available for purchase/subscription.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the product/service was added.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the product/service was last updated.

mallCategoryIds.description: References to MallCategories where this product or service is listed. (Relationship: MallCategory N:N ProductService)

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents a customer's purchase order for products or services from the Mall or Marketplace divisions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Order entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who placed the order. (Relationship: User 1:N Order)

orderDate.description: The date and time when the order was placed.

totalAmount.description: The total monetary amount of the order, including VAT and shipping.

currency.description: The currency of the total order amount (e.g., 'ZAR').

status.description: The current status of the order (e.g., 'pending', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled', 'refunded').

shippingAddress.description: The full shipping address for the order.

billingAddress.description: The full billing address for the order.

paymentId.description: Reference to the Payment associated with this order. (Relationship: Order 1:1 Payment)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the order record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the order record was last updated.

OrderItem.title: OrderItem
OrderItem.description: Represents a single item within an Order, detailing the specific product/service and quantity purchased.

id.description: Unique identifier for the OrderItem entity.

orderId.description: Reference to the Order this item belongs to. (Relationship: Order 1:N OrderItem)

productServiceId.description: Reference to the ProductService purchased. (Relationship: ProductService 1:N OrderItem)

quantity.description: The quantity of the product or service ordered.

unitPrice.description: The price of a single unit of the product or service at the time of order.

subtotal.description: The calculated subtotal for this order item (quantity * unitPrice).

SaaSComponent.title: SaaSComponent
SaaSComponent.description: Defines a modular component of the platform offered on a SaaS basis by the Tech Division.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SaaSComponent entity.

name.description: The name of the SaaS component (e.g., 'Fleet Tracking Module', 'Warehouse Management API').

description.description: A detailed description of the SaaS component's functionality.

basePrice.description: The base price for subscribing to this SaaS component.

currency.description: The currency of the base price (e.g., 'ZAR').

features.description: A list of key features included with the SaaS component.

documentationUrl.description: URL to the official documentation for the SaaS component.

isActive.description: Indicates if the SaaS component is currently active and available for subscription.

UserSaaSSubscription.title: UserSaaSSubscription
UserSaaSSubscription.description: Tracks a user's subscription to a specific SaaSComponent, including start/end dates and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserSaaSSubscription entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who subscribed to the SaaS component. (Relationship: User 1:N UserSaaSSubscription)

saasComponentId.description: Reference to the SaaSComponent subscribed to. (Relationship: SaaSComponent 1:N UserSaaSSubscription)

startDate.description: The date when the SaaS subscription became active.

endDate.description: The date when the SaaS subscription is set to expire.

status.description: The current status of the SaaS subscription (e.g., 'active', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'trial').

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the SaaS subscription record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the SaaS subscription record was last updated.

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Records significant user or system activities for auditing, analytics, and data harvesting purposes.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ActivityLog entry.

userId.description: Reference to the User who performed the action, if applicable. (Relationship: User 1:N ActivityLog)

action.description: A description of the action performed (e.g., 'User Login', 'Product Added', 'Membership Purchased').

entityType.description: The type of entity affected by the action (e.g., 'User', 'ProductService', 'Order').

entityId.description: The ID of the specific entity affected by the action.

timestamp.description: The date and time when the action occurred.

details.description: Additional context or details about the activity, possibly a JSON string or descriptive text.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed following the core principles of Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and Access Modeling to ensure security, scalability, and debuggability. All authorization logic is kept simple by minimizing `get()` calls in security rules and relying on path-based ownership or denormalized ownership fields. 

**Authorization Independence (Strategy A):**
- For user-specific subcollections (e.g., `memberships`, `payments`, `loans`, `orders`, `saasSubscriptions`), the `userId` field is explicitly denormalized within each document. This means that a document in `/users/{userId}/memberships/{userMembershipId}` will contain `userId: '{userId}'`. This allows rules to verify ownership (`request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId`) directly on the document without needing to perform a `get()` operation on a parent document.
- For `ProductService` documents, which are owned by a `Vendor` (which in turn is owned by a `User`), the `ownerUserId` (the `userId` of the Vendor's managing user) is denormalized into each `ProductService` document. This allows security rules to check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerUserId` for vendor-owned product modifications without needing to fetch the `Vendor` document.
- Similarly, `OrderItem` documents denormalize the `userId` (owner of the parent `Order`) to ensure atomic operations and simple ownership checks.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters) (Principle 4 & Strategy B/C):**
- **Structural Segregation:** Data is segregated into collections based on its security posture:
    - Global, publicly readable data (e.g., `membershipPlans`, `mallCategories`, `saasComponents`) are placed in root-level collections, allowing simple rules like `allow read: true;`.
    - Private user data is strictly isolated under `/users/{userId}/...` paths, making ownership explicit and ensuring `list` operations automatically filter by `request.auth.uid` if `userId` is part of the path.
    - For `list` operations on collections like `users/{userId}/memberships`, the denormalized `userId` field allows efficient queries like `db.collection('users').doc(request.auth.uid).collection('memberships').where('userId', '==', request.auth.uid)` directly enforceable by rules, thus supporting QAPs. Similarly, a user can query their `vendors` or `productServices` using `ownerUserId` filters.
- **Path-Based Ownership:** The pattern `/users/{userId}/<subcollection>/...` is heavily utilized for user-owned entities like `UserMembership`, `Payment`, `Loan`, `Order`, and `UserSaaSSubscription`, making authorization concise and efficient.
- **DBAC for Global Roles (Strategy C):** Admin roles are implemented via a dedicated collection `/roles_assigned_admin/{userId}` where the existence of a document signifies admin status for `userId`. This supports `allow read: if exists(/databases/$(database)/documents/roles_assigned_admin/$(request.auth.uid));` which is simple and adheres to DBAC principles.

**Data Clarity and Predictability (Strategy D):**
- Consistent naming conventions like `userId`, `ownerUserId`, `membershipPlanId` are used throughout.
- Explicit `status` fields (e.g., in `UserMembership`, `Payment`, `Loan`, `Order`, `UserSaaSSubscription`) are used for finite state modeling, avoiding inferred states from multiple flags or timestamps.
- Wildcards in paths are descriptive (e.g., `{userId}`, `{vendorId}`, `{orderId}`).
